name: Tibber
description: The electricity price of this hour on your Tibber contract
comment: GraphQL over POST with a bearer token; GDash sends the User-Agent that Tibber asks for. Tibber asks to fetch prices sparingly and publishes no numeric limit, so it refreshes every 15 minutes. currentSubscription is null for a home without an active contract. The level values (VERY_CHEAP to VERY_EXPENSIVE) come from client libraries, not the guide (unverified).

source.name: Tibber price
source.secretHint: Make a personal access token at developer.tibber.com, under Access Token.

rule.summary: show Price level in the warning colour when it is expensive
